item.title: Service is operating normally: [RESOLVED] Increased API Error Rates
item.description: Between 2:10 AM and 2:55 AM PDT we saw increased API error rates for the RunInstances API. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.

item.title: Increased API Error Rates
item.description:
We are investigating increased API error rates & latencies for the RunInstances API in the EU-WEST-2 Region.

Existing instances are not affected.
